additional_info.subject: RE: 0389391 - ID0389391-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002517]  both outlets are out of order. CRM:02023000290
additional_info.body:
Dear Basheer,
As checked on SCB, the error of SafetyRelay_QA26 is because of Emergency button SF2 pressed. Please release the emergency button & check.
Also, there is an issue with both IMD_BC1 and IMD_BC2.
Resolution
MB-Er:0 IsoWarn/Fail/PEConn:0 Capa:0 RlyConn:0 Init:0 SIS:0
MB-Er:
0: if no new data from IMD received within 5s this error gets active
IsoWarn/Fail/PEConn:
0: no error1: Isolationrestance pre-Warning Level reached2: connection to PE is corrupt4: Isolationrestance Warning Level reached5: Isolationsrestance Failure Level Reached
Capa:
2: maximum Y-capacity is exceeded at the DC output
RlyConn:
0: connection of the relays for signaling isowarning/ -failure is not tested1: Bender Relay iso test is valid2: Bender Relay for warning is triggered (iso warning Rf<500kOhm)3: Bender Relay for fault is triggered (iso fault Rf<100kOhm)
Init:
0: not initialized1: IMD is initialized and selfcheck is performed
SIS standby isolation status:
0: value not valid (modbus values != relay values)1:  value is valid, set from Modbus & is equal to relay insulation status2: iso warning Rf<500kOhm3: iso fault Rf<100kOhm
- Please reboot the charger and check if the IMD fault is acknowledged.
- If the fault is not acknowledged, verify the R1 and R2 values in the IMD.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
